title: Nvidia up 1.2% on UAE chip deal — and TSMC is moving for the same reason

beats.narration: Nvidia is up 1.2% in pre-market after the U.S. approved chip exports worth billions to the United Arab Emirates.
The approval falls under the May AI agreement, designed to accelerate UAE data centers building advanced AI models.
The deal covers up to 500,000 chips per year through 2030. In return, the UAE committed to large investments in the United States.
But Nvidia isn't the only chipmaker moving today.
Taiwan Semiconductor is up 1.8% after reporting a sharp jump in Q3 revenue, above market forecasts.
The company manufactures chips for both Nvidia and Apple, riding massive orders for AI data centers and high-performance servers.
Analysts say this cements TSMC's position as the backbone of the global chip industry and a key player in the AI race.
